profile.headline: Senior Associate Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
I will be using this section to describe the most recent work I've been doing and in what languages.

My work since October 2019 have been full stack work in React and ExpressJS

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead as the tech lead to build a new internal tool for the company with a small team of 4 people, including other software engineers and a UX designer.
- Built a new internal tool to track company spending on events and conferences to help the company learn how much they were spending a year. There was no way to do this company wide before until this tool was created. Frontend was built with NextJS, and Tailwind CSS. Backend was built with ExpressJS. Deployed on AWS Lambda.
- Rebuilt an entire Java/Springboot application into ExpressJS and moved it from AWS EC2 to AWS Lambda to save 90% in spending for the application and remove the need for any container maintenance and security issues.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a core feature which auto tagged every new dashboard and updated tags on every saved dashboard. This increased dashboard searches by 60%. Done in React.
- Developed a S3 plugin on our hard forked Grafana application to pull CSV files to parse into timeseries/table data to use along with Grafana data visualization tools. Done in Golang.

positions.title: TechStar (Software Engineer Intern)
positions.description:
Extended the MobileAppApi:
Created a ReST endpoint and service in C#
Integrated the new service with the Gateway in Java

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description: Assisting other students in Programming I on basic concepts for coding in Java.

projects.title: Check in or Register
projects.description:
•	Website designed to take information and store it using google spreadsheet, made with the intent to be used by clubs, allows students to check-in or allows the club to add new members to the database
•	Languages used: HTML, CSS, PYTHON
•	Frameworks used: Bootstrap, Flask

projects.title: VroomVroom(SwampHacks)
projects.description:
Program that allowed users to rate drivers from transportation companies such as Uber, Taxi, etc.... this would allow the user to feel safe with the company they chose for transportation. 
Languages Used: HTML & CSS, AngularJS,NodeJS, ExpressJS, and MongoDB
